def predict(posts):
    out = []
    for p in posts:
        s = (p['img'] * 4.0) - (p['link'] * 1.5) + (3.0 if 18 <= p['hour'] <= 23 else (1.0 if p['hour'] <= 6 else 1.5)) + sum(1 for c in p['text'] if c in "!！✨❤️😊") * 0.2
        s += (p['len'] / 300.0 if 20 <= p['len'] <= 150 else p['len'] / 600.0) if p['len'] > 50 else 0  
        out.append(s)
    return out
